basic.name: Flame Stream
basic.description: Fire two streams that deal 76~~0.04~~ damage to enemies hit, and an additional 120~~0.04~~ damage to non-Structure enemies hit by both streams. Flame Stream Ignites Oil Spills it comes in contact with.

basic.name: Oil Spill
basic.description:
Vector Targeting
Dispense a slick of oil that lasts for 5 seconds and Slows enemies that come in contact with it by 50%.

Oil Spills are Ignited for 2.5 seconds when hit by Flame Stream. Ignited Oil Spills no longer Slow enemies, but instead deal 16~~0.04~~ damage to them every 0.3 seconds. Additionally, Blaze is healed for 49~~0.04~~ Health every 0.3 seconds while standing in Ignited Oil Spills.

Stores up to 2 charges.

basic.name: Jet Propulsion
basic.description: After 0.375 seconds, charge forward. Colliding with an enemy Hero deals 52~~0.04~~ damage to all nearby enemy Heroes and Stuns them for 1.25 seconds.

basic.name: Flamethrower
basic.description: Deal 150~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in a line.

basic.name: Oil Spill
basic.description:
Vector Targeting
Dispense an Oil Spill that Slows enemies and can be set on fire by Blaze.

heroic.name: Bunker Drop
heroic.description:
After 0.5 seconds, deploy and enter a Bunker with 1435~~0.04~~ Health. Blaze and his allies can enter and exit the Bunker at will. While in the Bunker, occupants gain access to Flamethrower, dealing 150~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in a line. 

Exiting the Bunker grants 25 Armor for 2 seconds. Bunkers last 10 seconds, or until destroyed.

heroic.name: Combustion
heroic.description:
Channel for up to 2.6 seconds. Upon ending, Slow nearby enemies by 60% and deal 55~~0.04~~ damage to them every 0.5 seconds. Combustion's Slow and damage over time duration is extended the longer Blaze Channels, from 1 second up to 5 seconds.

Blaze's Movement Speed is reduced by 40% while Channeling.

trait.name: Pyromania
trait.description:
Gain 40 Armor and deal 40~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds for 4 seconds.

Each Hero hit by Flame Stream reduces Pyromania's cooldown by 4 seconds.

activable.name: Adrenaline Stimpack
activable.description:
Passive: While over 80% Health, gain 20% bonus Attack Speed and 10% bonus Movement Speed.

Activate to gain 85% Attack Speed and 25% Movement Speed for 5 seconds.

activable.name: Endurance Stimpack
activable.description:
Activate to gain a Shield that absorbs 590~~0.04~~ damage over 5 seconds.

When taking damage while below 30% maximum Health, Endurance Stimpack will automatically be cast if it is not on cooldown.

activable.name: Neural Stimpack
activable.description: Activate to gain 40 Mana and cause Basic Ability cooldowns to recharge 100% faster for 5 seconds.

activable.name: Juggernaut Plating
activable.description: Activate to gain 50 Spell Armor for 3 seconds. Upon expiration, gain a Shield equal to 125% of the Spell Damage taken while Juggernaut Plating was active.

level1.name: Adrenaline Stimpack
level1.description:

Activate to gain 85% Attack Speed and 25% Movement Speed for 5 seconds.

When taking damage while below 30% maximum Health, Endurance Stimpack will automatically be cast if it is not on cooldown.

level1.name: Neural Stimpack
level1.description: Activate to gain 40 Mana and cause Basic Ability cooldowns to recharge 100% faster for 5 seconds.

level1.name: New Habits
level1.description:
Collecting Regeneration Globes reduces the cooldown of Pyromania by 6 seconds.

Quest: Collect 15 Regeneration Globes.

Reward: Pyromania grants Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

level4.name: Oil Dispersal
level4.description: Increase Oil Spill's area by 20%. Each enemy Hero hit by Flame Stream reduces the cooldown of Oil Spill by 0.75 seconds and refunds 5 Mana.

level4.name: Meltdown
level4.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Pyromania reduces their damage dealt by 8% for 2.5 seconds, up to 40%.

level4.name: Incinerator Gauntlets
level4.description: Increase Basic Attack area by 15%, and Basic Attack damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters by 40%.

level7.name: Suppressive Fire
level7.description: Each stream of Flame Stream reduces the Spell Power of Heroes hit by 20% for 4 seconds, up to 40%.

level7.name: Nanomachine Coating
level7.description: Enemies standing in Oil Spills and Ignited Oil Spills have their Attack Speed reduced by 35% for 4 seconds.

level7.name: Fuel Leak
level7.description: Jet Propulsion creates Oil Spills along Blaze's path. If Jet Propulsion impacts an enemy Hero, an additional Oil Spill is created underneath them.

level10.description:

Exiting the Bunker grants 25 Armor for 2 seconds. Bunkers last 10 seconds, or until destroyed.

level13.name: Grill and Kill
level13.description:
Increase Ignited Oil Spill damage by 45%.

Quest: Damage enemy Heroes with Ignited Oil Spills 30 times.

Reward: Increase Oil Spill's Ignite duration by 2.5 seconds.

level13.name: Adhesive Petroleum
level13.description: Enemies standing in Oil Spill when it is Ignited are Slowed by 40% and take 35% more Basic Attack damage from Blaze for 3 seconds. Additionally, Basic Attack splashes Ignite Oil Spills.

level13.name: Collision Course
level13.description: Jet Propulsion's collision deals 260~~0.04~~ damage to the first enemy Hero hit.

level16.name: Thermal Protection
level16.description: Each enemy hit by Jet Propulsion grants 10 Armor for 3 seconds and reduces its cooldown by 1.25 seconds.

level16.name: Heat Treatment
level16.description: Heal for 75% of the damage dealt by Pyromania.

level16.name: Juggernaut Plating
level16.description: Activate to gain 50 Spell Armor for 3 seconds. Upon expiration, gain a Shield equal to 125% of the Spell Damage taken while Juggernaut Plating was active.

level20.name: Fortified Bunker
level20.description: Occupants can cast Oil Spill from Bunker Drop every 6 seconds. Additionally, Bunker Drop's Armor bonus upon exiting is increased by 25, and its duration by 1 second.

level20.name: Flash Fire
level20.description: While Channeling Combustion, Blaze's Movement Speed is no longer reduced, and nearby enemies are Slowed by 60%.

level20.name: Burn Notice
level20.description: Basic Attacks Slow enemies by 5% and deal an additional 18~~0.04~~ damage over 2.5 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.
